name: junto
description: Screen share ao vivo com audio e baixa latencia, P2P (WebRTC). Host = Electron, viewer = navegador.

scripts.setup: npm install && node node_modules/electron/install.js && npm run build:libs
scripts.build: npm run build:libs && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: node --test packages/rtc/test/sync.test.mjs packages/rtc/test/codec.test.mjs packages/rtc/test/signaling-client.test.mjs packages/rtc/test/bitrate-budget.test.mjs packages/rtc/test/sdp-video.test.mjs packages/rtc/test/stats.test.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run build:libs && npm run build -w @junto/web && npm run build -w @junto/signaling && node server/signaling/dist/index.js
